scope: TAR UMT university inquiry prototype. Time-sensitive answers route users to official primary sources.

responses: Hello! I can help you find official TAR UMT information about programmes, admissions, fees, intakes, accommodation and campus services. What would you like to know?
Goodbye! Please verify any time-sensitive details on the official TAR UMT website before acting on them: https://www.tarc.edu.my/
